title: Simulation away from oracle queries
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $m$ ordinary work tapes over the Boolean alphabet, let $O$ be a language of Boolean words, and let $P$ be a Turing machine with $k$ work tapes and state set $H$. Suppose $\\iota$ is an injection from the $m+2$ tape indices of the shadow simulation into the $k$ tapes of $P$, and $emb$ is an injection from pairs $(q,b)$, where $q$ is a state of $M$ and $b\in\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, into $H$. Fix arbitrary contents and head positions for the tapes of $P$. Assume that, for every such pair with $q$ different from the query state, every scanned input symbol, and every tuple of scanned work-tape symbols, the transition of $P$ at state $emb(q,b)$ agrees with the state-renamed transition of the shadow simulation of $M$ with the empty oracle. Let $c$ be a configuration of $M$ on a Boolean input, and suppose its query-tape head position is nonnegative if $b$ is true and nonpositive if $b$ is false. If the empty-oracle computation from $c$ is outside the query state at every time $s<t$, then there is a Boolean tag $b'$ such that the query-tape head position after $t$ steps of $M$ relative to $O$ is nonnegative when $b'$ is true and nonpositive when $b'$ is false, and the configuration of $P$ after $t$ steps from the encoded configuration of $c$ with tag $b$ equals the encoding of the configuration of $M$ after $t$ steps relative to $O$ with tag $b'$.
